At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations. Yours Team's Impact Network engineers at FactSet have a wide variety of responsibilities across the enterprise’s entire infrastructure. The role primarily consists of designing, automating, operating and troubleshooting FactSet’s various network systems, including but not limited to our WAN, LAN, SAN, WiFi, Load-balancing, Internet Ingress/Egress, DNS, AWS Cloud Networking, Network Automation and Market data environments. This broad range of technologies, coupled with the nature of the position, often result in an engineer being required to quickly [re]acclimate themselves with a technology, become a subject matter expert in that domain, fix the problem/implement a solution and then move on to the next initiative. For those who have the skills and work ethic to thrive in our environment, the position poses a challenging but rewarding and exciting opportunity for engineers to deliver top-tier service to our internal and external clients. Candidates for this position should have solid experience with WAN/LAN technologies, TCP/IP, routing protocols and have a deep understanding of reference network architectures along with a significant level of ‘Hands On’ network OS experience. Additionally, candidates with a solid track record of interaction with ISPs, familiarity with automation tools, multicast experience, strong analytical, project management and troubleshooting skills will receive a higher level of consideration. Past success designing or maintaining a network via automation is also expected. Candidates should have competence in at least one scripting language and experience with standard automation tools. A successful candidate for this position will have strong interpersonal skills, an elevated level of verbal and written dexterity and will enjoy providing effective and meaningful solutions for clients, both internal and external. What You'll Do Act as a strong consultative resource for FactSet's clients, vendors, and internal leaders. Project manage business and network team initiatives. Configure Cisco/Arista routers and switches, F5 Load Balancers, DNS platforms, and AWS cloud networking resources to provide reliable and scalable services. Build solid and long-lived relationships with FactSet's clients and internal stakeholders. Serve as an escalation point for network incidents and advanced Layer 1-7 troubleshooting. Design, implement, and support enterprise network services including routing, switching, DNS, load balancing, cloud networking, and Internet connectivity. Streamline existing and new processes using automation, templates, Infrastructure-as-Code, and workflow systems. Develop and maintain automation solutions using Python, Anisble, Terraform, APIs, and infrastructure automation tools. Build and support API-driven integrations across networking, cloud, DNS, load balancing, and security platforms. Collaborate with cloud and platform engineering teams to support networking requirements for containerized and Kubernetes-based workloads. Drive operational efficiency through automation, standardization, and self-service infrastructure capabilities. Lead and mentor junior engineers to help them achieve their career and project goals. AnsibleParticipate in shift rotation for weekend on-call coverage. What We're Looking For BS degree in an engineering discipline or equivalent. Relevant experience of 4-8 years. Ability to be self-sufficient and quickly learn new technologies. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, architecture, and operational best practices. Collaborate with engineering, operations, architecture, and software development teams to integrate automation, telemetry, and data-driven workflows into network operations. review_candidates.title: Manufacturing IT Specialist
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Manufacturing IT Specialist to help keep our shop floor systems running. In this role, you will be the day-to-day support contact for our SAP manufacturing and warehouse applications (MES and EWM) and for the SCADA and data collection systems that connect them to production equipment. You will work directly with production, warehouse, quality, and maintenance teams — troubleshooting issues, keeping data flowing between the plant floor and SAP, and helping roll out improvements. This is a hands-on learning role, not a senior architect position. We are looking for solid fundamentals, curiosity, and a willingness to be on the plant floor. If you have a relevant degree or a couple of years of manufacturing IT, help desk, controls, or ERP support experience, we will train you on the rest. SAP MES / EWM Support Provide first- and second-level support for SAP manufacturing execution and Extended Warehouse Management users, including production reporting, material movements, goods receipts, picking, packing, and shipping transactions. Log, track, and resolve incidents and service requests; escalate complex issues to senior team members or external partners with clear documentation of what was tried. Monitor interfaces and background jobs between SAP and shop floor systems; identify failed or stuck transactions and correct them or coordinate the fix. Support master data accuracy for production and warehouse objects (materials, work centers, routings, storage bins, handling units) in coordination with business owners. Assist with testing, validation, and cutover activities for SAP changes, transports, patches, and new plant rollouts. Help train end users and write plain-language work instructions, quick reference guides, and troubleshooting steps. SCADA and Shop Floor Systems Support daily operation of SCADA / HMI applications used to monitor and control production lines, including alarm review, tag and screen changes, and basic configuration. Troubleshoot data collection issues between production equipment, PLCs, OPC servers, historians, and SAP — determining whether a problem is network, device, application, or data related. Maintain and support shop floor hardware and peripherals: industrial PCs, thin clients, barcode scanners, label printers, RF devices, wireless access points, and scoreboards or andon displays. Perform routine health checks, backups, patching, and license and certificate renewals on shop floor servers and workstations, following change control procedures. Assist with OT network hygiene and cybersecurity basics such as account reviews, segmentation checks, antivirus and patch compliance, and documenting connected devices. Projects and Continuous Improvement Participate as a team member on projects such as new line installations, equipment integrations, label or scanning changes, and MES or EWM enhancements. Gather requirements from plant users, document current and future state processes, and support configuration and testing. Keep system documentation, diagrams, and asset inventories current. Look for recurring issues and suggest permanent fixes or automation instead of repeat manual workarounds. Support after-hours changes and provide on-call coverage on a rotating basis to protect production schedules. To be a qualified candidate, you must have the following: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Technology, Electrical or Mechatronics Engineering, Automation, or a related field; OR a minimum of two (2) years of relevant work experience in place of a degree. Exposure to at least one of the following, through coursework, internship, co-op, or work experience: an ERP system (SAP preferred), a manufacturing execution or warehouse management system, or a SCADA / HMI / PLC environment. Basic troubleshooting ability across Windows operating systems, networking fundamentals (IP addressing, DNS, switches, VLANs), and relational databases. Comfortable reading data and writing basic queries (SQL) or scripts to investigate an issue. Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain a technical issue to a production supervisor and a business issue to a developer. Strong customer service mindset and the patience to support users during a live production shift. Willingness to work on the plant floor and to be available for occasional off-shift, weekend, or on-call support. Key to being successful in this role: Not required — these are what would make an application stand out. Hands-on experience with SAP ME / MII / Digital Manufacturing, or SAP EWM or WM transactions and RF handheld processes. Familiarity with a SCADA or industrial platform such as Ignition, AVEVA / Wonderware, FactoryTalk, WinCC, or Kepware, or with OPC UA data connectivity. Exposure to PLC platforms (Siemens, Allen-Bradley / Rockwell, Mitsubishi) at a read-and-understand level. Understanding of barcode and label printing (Zebra, SATO, BarTender, ZPL) and of RF / handheld scanning workflows. Experience in an automotive, Tier 1 supplier, or other high-volume manufacturing environment. Familiarity with ITIL-style incident and change management, or with a ticketing system such as ServiceNow or Jira. Scripting or reporting skills (Python, PowerShell, Power BI) and an interest in shop floor analytics. Relevant certifications (CompTIA A+ / Network+, SAP associate-level, or vendor automation training). Additional language skills, particularly Mandarin, given our global engineering and IT teams. Work Environment And Physical Requirements Split time between an office setting and an active manufacturing and warehouse floor. Required personal protective equipment (safety glasses, hearing protection, safety shoes) must be worn in designated areas; exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures. Frequent walking and standing throughout the facility; occasional lifting of equipment up to 25–50 lbs and use of ladders or lifts for device installations. Ability to work occasional off-shift hours, planned weekend maintenance windows, and rotating on-call support. Why work for Minth? Here are the advantages of working at Minth. International development platform Dynamic and efficient team All-round personal improvement Personalized humanistic care Diversified working atmosphere Modern office setting Competitive compensation packag e Minth Windsor Manufacturing Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds. We are committed to providing accommodations for applicants with disabilities in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) . If you require an accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know

Mentor cloud and platform engineers, sharing expertise and raising the technical bar across the team. Contribute to and help shape the technical strategy and roadmap for infrastructure and platform engineering. Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure Drive cloud architecture and account strategy across development, staging, and production environments for a regulated lending platform. Drive adoption of infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices across infrastructure operations. Own container orchestration across multiple deployable services and cloud accounts. Experience with CDN/edge/WAF platforms (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai) for content delivery, DDoS protection, edge security, and traffic/performance optimization. Security, Identity & Compliance Own identity management, account-level security posture, secrets management, and KMS key strategy. Partner with security and compliance teams on audits and vendor/security assessments for a regulated financial services platform. Developer Experience & CI/CD Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines across multiple repositories, from build through environment-gated production deployments. Drive best-in-class developer experience and internal tooling for engineering teams. Reliability & Incident Management Contribute to on-call and incident-response practices, including postmortems, for a platform where downtime directly impacts loan funding and servicing. AI-Native Platform Engineering Evaluate and drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) across infrastructure workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and internal tooling to accelerate delivery. Own the infrastructure strategy for ML/AI-driven product features (e.g., underwriting and fraud models), including model serving, inference monitoring, and compute scaling for AI workloads. Champion a builder's mindset toward internal developer platforms — self-service tooling and golden paths that let engineers ship safely without waiting on the platform team. Substantial hands-on experience with public cloud platform services such as AWS, Azure, and GCP. Hands-on coding experience in at least two programming languages (Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, or .NET/C#). Experience with cloud-native application patterns and tools, microservices architectures, and application migrations to any cloud platform. Working understanding of infrastructure, virtualization, containers, networking, storage, and monitoring and logging/analytics tools (e.g., Splunk). Experience with application performance management tools (Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, Dynatrace, etc.). Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools and processes (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Ansible). Experience with developer tools and open-source technologies. Working familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps concepts and the infrastructure needs of AI/ML workloads (GPU or accelerator provisioning, model serving, inference cost and latency management). Hands-on use of AI coding assistants and developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) in real engineering workflows. Familiarity with policy-as-code (e.g., OPA, Kyverno) and software supply chain security practices (SBOM generation, artifact signing/provenance) as applied to CI/CD pipelines. Substantial hands-on experience with public cloud platform services such as AWS, Azure, and GCP. Experience with cloud-native application patterns and tools, microservices architectures, and application migrations to any cloud platform. Strong understanding of infrastructure, virtualization, containers, networking, storage, and monitoring and logging/analytics tools (e.g., Splunk). Experience with application performance management tools (Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, Dynatrace, etc.). Deep expertise in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools and processes (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Ansible). Extensive experience with developer tools and open-source technologies. Extensive hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic developer tools in real engineering workflows, with the judgment to evaluate where they create leverage vs. risk. Experience with policy-as-code (e.g., OPA, Kyverno) and software supply chain security practices (SBOM generation, artifact signing/provenance) as applied to CI/CD pipelines. THE ROLE Propel enterprise operational readiness across Everpure by operating the core execution engine of our global resilience program. As an Operational Resilience Specialist, you will drive the end-to-end consistency, throughput, and accuracy of critical Business Impact Assessments (BIAs), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), and issue tracking systems. Partnering cross-functionally with system owners, IT operations, and risk leadership, you ensure our risk profile remains transparent and actionable, directly safeguarding organizational business continuity at scale. Coordinate Backup and Restore Readiness: Work with IT operations, system owners, and application teams to validate backup coverage, retention, restore procedures, and recovery dependencies. Manage Corrective Action & Escalation Pipelines: Direct the lifecycle tracking of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) arising from incidents, tabletop exercises, and audits, directly engaging action item owners to resolve delays and maintain accurate remediation records. Oversee Tool Integrity & System Reporting: Administer data entry and ongoing maintenance within Everpure’s enterprise governance and resilience tools, performing regular quality audits to provide leadership with clean, decision-ready compliance reporting. Coordinate Resilience Exercises & Process Improvement: Lead logistics, participant coordination, and documentation for simulation exercises, capturing output metrics and refining standard operating templates to continually elevate program delivery. What You Bring Execution & Ownership Discipline: Proven track record of managing multiple operational deliverables to closure with high detail orientation, structured follow-through, and reliable data management. Disaster Recovery & Backup/Recovery Expertise: Practical working experience supporting disaster recovery planning, testing, DRPs, and recovery procedures, along with strong knowledge of backup, restore, and recovery workflows, including backup coverage, retention, validation steps, recovery dependencies, and RTO/RPO considerations. Provide technical guidance and enablement to engineering teams consuming Azure platform services. Job Overview If you're a Senior Data & DevOps Engineer who thrives at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and AI innovation, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact. In this role, you’ll serve as a trusted advisor and hands-on expert, partnering across business units and IT to architect and optimize our Azure-based enterprise data platform. You’ll mentor engineering teams, champion best practices, and drive automation and scalability through modern DevOps and data engineering tools. We’re looking for someone who brings deep expertise in the Microsoft Azure data ecosystem, a passion for building resilient, future-ready platforms, and a desire to shape the next generation of data and AI capabilities at Charles River. If you’re energized by solving complex challenges, influencing architectural decisions, and enabling transformative analytics, we’d love to connect with you. Key Duties & Responsibilities Build, administer and deploy key infrastructure within the Azure Cloud supporting a wide variety of technology solutions. Working specifically with services in Azure such as Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, Azure Data Factory, Azure Service Bus, Azure Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Azure SQL Database, Azure DNS, Virtual Network, Azure App Service. Build core cloud infrastructure using Terraform (Infrastructure As Code). Manage code, CI/CD pipelines and documentation via Azure DevOps platform. Define and manage release workflows to update latest code to the corresponding environments. Enable developers with automation of deployments and testing frameworks Document, implement and audit security and access permissions for the data platform. Monitor nightly data pipelines to meet SLAs. Respond to alerts across many services related to the EDH platform providing timely and effective solutions. Create and standardize user communications for operations failures. Work within Agile squads delivering first in class technology solutions. This position will work remote from home office located in India. Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline, Master’s Degree preferred Minimum of 7 years related experience in Data and DevOps Engineering Minimum 5 years hands-on experience building infrastructure and technology solutions within the Azure cloud. Experience with the following services is preferable Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, Azure Data Factory, Azure Service Bus, Azure Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Azure SQL Database, Azure DNS, Virtual Network, Azure App Service. Hands on experience administering and using source control systems (GitHub, Azure DevOps). Hands on experience developing and maintaining CI\CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferable). Hands on experience deploying cloud Infrastructure As Code. Hands on experience automating processes using coded solutions (Powershell, Python preferable). Experience working with Agile squads Self-starter with the ability to work independently or as part of a project team. Capability to conduct performance analysis, troubleshooting and remediation. Interface with key customers from all functional areas. Proven and recent experience of implementing solutions from requirements gathering and process design to functional production deployment. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted as a satisfactory substitute for the specific education and experience listed above. Experience (preferred) Administering relational database management systems (RDMS). Experience in ETL design, development, and performance tuning in general. Experience managing and governing cloud costs. Experience working with other public cloud technologies AWS, GCP. Experience working with MS Fabric. Experience working AI tool stack in Azure. Other Excellent analytical and organization skills Ability to understand and translate business and end user requirements Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to navigate ambiguity and define desired outcome Strong attention to detail About Corporate Functions The Corporate Functions provide operational support across Charles River in areas such as Human Resources, Finance, IT, Legal, Sales, Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Corporate Development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market. With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world. review_candidates.description: Overview Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted. The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues. The Acquisition and Technology Analysis Group within JOID specializes in the application of multi-disciplinary analytic skills to support multiple clients within the Department of Defense (DoD). These clients include the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)), Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment (OUSD(A&S)), DARPA, the Joint Staff, and USINDOPACOM. SPA provides critical decision support to enabling and executing a strategy of technological superiority and enabling the delivery and sustainment of secure, resilient, and preeminent capabilities to the warfighter quickly and cost effectively. Our team of experienced military, technical, and operations research analysts is skilled in evaluating military problems, identifying the driving factors, devising innovative approaches, collecting applicable data, developing necessary software tools, and performing thorough and timely assessments to inform technology and acquisition governance decisions to ensure U.S. military forces retain military superiority in the future. We have an immediate need for a Business Process Transformation Analyst to provide onsite support out of the Pentagon in Arlington, VA. Responsibilities The Business Process Transformation Analyst will serve as an OUSD (R&E) expert for reengineering administrative, workflow, and records processes using Microsoft 365 cloud technologies. This role will bridge operations with modern digital tools to improve correspondence management, task tracking, document control, performance reporting, and knowledge management. The position supports enterprise-level improvements across Front Office operations through design, analytics, and implementation of digital solutions. Analyze existing business processes (workflows, correspondence routing, records management, administrative operations) and develop modernization plans creating SharePoint Online, Power BI, and other Microsoft 365 capabilities consistent with continuous improvement objectives. Develop SharePoint-based digital records systems compliant with WHS AI-15, NARA standards, and R&E records SOPs, supporting electronic records programs. Create interactive Power BI dashboards that enable leadership visibility of CATMS taskers, travel trackers, operational metrics, workflow aging reports, and performance management data. Establish document quality control protocols for Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Adobe PDF files to meet senior-level expectations for accuracy, readability, formatting, coordination, and compliance with PRS and Part 5 deliverable standards. Build automated workflows using Microsoft 365 SharePoint to streamline correspondence preparation, document reviews, calendar support materials, briefing products, and coordination processes. Support Operations Managers and Project Managers with digital tools for tracking tasks, milestones, workflows, SOP updates, and process refinements. Enhance knowledge management by creating standardized Microsoft SharePoint digital libraries, templates, dashboards, and document repositories tailored to senior leader needs. Conduct training, readiness assessments, and user adoption support to ensure personnel integrate new digital processes into daily operations. Ensure compliance with DoD information security, CUI, and accessibility standards, including Section 508, DoDM 5200.01, DFARS safeguarding requirements, and organizational security policies. Serve on an executive Front Office operations team that provides interface for the organization by professionally managing communications and engagements with the public, internal stakeholders, and senior officials; prepare and coordinate high‑quality written correspondence; maintain awareness of inquiry topics to ensure proper routing within the R&E enterprise; and support essential Front Office administrative functions—including visitor coordination, office security procedures, scheduling, workflow management, and upkeep of office appearance—to support an efficient, high‑paced executive environment. Qualifications Required: 10+ years of recent and relevant experience providing high-quality support to Executive-level personnel in fast-paced and complex environments. Bachelor’s degree. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership and external organizations. Strong initiative, exceptional organizational skills, and high proficiency in CATMS. Proven experience in correspondence management and coordination, with a focus on drafting and reviewing documents for senior leadership. High proficiency in Microsoft 365 suite, SharePoint, and DoD365 Copilot, Power Platform, and applications. Strong knowledge of records management practices and demonstrated skills in training and process improvement. Active TS/SCI clearance. Able to work fully onsite based on client needs. Desired Experience working within the DoD or familiarity with military protocols, policies, and operations. Familiarity with National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) requirements for records management. Pay Range Information At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Virginia, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $120,000.00/Yr. - USD $140,000.00/Yr.

new_matches.title: DevSecOps Engineer (Ref 101)
new_matches.company: SG It Consultancy & Services Pvt. Ltd.
new_matches.description: Responsibilities Responsible for designing, automating, and maintaining secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure and deployment pipelines. The role requires expertise in cloud platforms, automation, security best practices, and modern DevOps methodologies. Develop automation and processes to enable teams to deploy, manage, scale and monitor applications in data centers and cloud environments. Troubleshoot and resolve system and application issues across platforms, participating in on-call escalations for critical incidents. Take ownership of end-to-end infrastructure and security solutions across the organization. Deploy and manage monitoring tools to track infrastructure performance, utilization, and health. Implement configuration management systems for business continuity and automate disaster recovery measures. Provision virtual machines, databases, application containers, and licenses for development teams. Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines, incorporating streamlined change management and release processes. Develop scripts and automation tools to support software build, integration, and deployment across development and production environments. Automate the configuration management of development, quality assurance and production workloads. Design, build, optimize, and monitor automation systems to identify bottlenecks and maximize service availability. Requirement Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines. Passion for automation, standardization, and best practices in infrastructure and security. Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle(SDLC), Test- Driven Development (TDD), Continuous Integration (CI), and Continuous Delivery (CD). Experience working with high availability, high performance, and high security multi-data center systems and hybrid cloud environments. Proficiency in at least three programming/scripting languages (Bash, PowerShell, Python, Go). – Experience with Git and modern branching workflows. Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Experience with automated provisioning tools (Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, Vagrant). Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies (KVM, VMware, Hyper-V). Strong understanding of container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF)tools(Prometheus, Helm, ArgoCD, Istio, Gatekeeper, Crossplane). Experience with infrastructure monitoring and observability tools. Strong ability to troubleshoot complex issues across system resources and application stacks. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools(GitLab, Jenkins, BitBucket, ArgoCD). Interested applicants, Please send your updated resume in Word format to hres@itcspl.com Please indicate Job Code "DevSecOps Engineer - 101" on email subject We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Bacalso John Bryan Bedayo ( Reg No. R1106648) IT Consultancy & Services Pte Ltd EA No: 92C5311 Please visit www.itcspl.com to learn more information about ITC

new_matches.title: Network Reliability Engineer
new_matches.description: Make your mark at Comcast -- a Fortune 30 global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, we reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. Become part of our award-winning technology team that turns big ideas into cutting-edge products, platforms, and solutions that our customers love. We create space to innovate, and we recognize, reward, and invest in your ideas, while ensuring you can proudly bring your authentic self to the workplace. Join us. You’ll do the best work of your career right here at Comcast. (In most cases, Comcast prefers to have employees on-site collaborating unless the team has been designated as virtual due to the nature of their work. If a position is listed with both office locations and virtual offerings, Comcast may be willing to consider candidates who live greater than 100 miles from the office for the remote option.) Job Summary Comcast is seeking an Engineer 2, Network Engineering to support the lifecycle management of critical core network infrastructure across one of the nation's largest telecommunications networks. This role is responsible for developing and supporting automation solutions that enable the deployment, augmentation, upgrade, migration, and decommissioning of core network devices throughout their operational lifecycle. The successful candidate will combine networking expertise with software development and automation capabilities to improve configuration management, compliance validation, deployment processes, operational visibility, and network reliability. Working closely with engineering, operations, and architecture teams, this individual will help accelerate the modernization and scalability of Comcast's core network infrastructure while ensuring operational excellence across multi-vendor environments. Job Description This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship. To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future. Responsible for supporting the engineering, automation, and lifecycle management of core network infrastructure. Contributes to the deployment, augmentation, modernization, migration, and retirement of critical network devices that support Comcast's core network environment. Uses networking, software development, and automation expertise to design and improve platforms, processes, and tools that streamline device lifecycle activities, configuration management, compliance validation, operational reporting, and large-scale network deployments. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable automation solutions that enhance network reliability, operational efficiency, and service delivery. What You'll Do Support the full lifecycle of network infrastructure, including deployment, upgrades, migrations, modernization initiatives, capacity expansion, and decommissioning activities. Develop and maintain Python-based automation solutions for network provisioning, configuration management, validation, compliance, and operational efficiency. Assist with network audits, configuration validation, compliance reporting, and large-scale configuration deployment across multi-vendor environments. Analyze network telemetry, operational data, configurations, and system logs to identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and improve network performance and reliability. Collaborate with engineering, operations, architecture, and software development teams to integrate automation, telemetry, and data-driven workflows into network operations. Support network changes, software upgrades, and infrastructure transformation initiatives while ensuring operational stability and deployment quality. Build and enhance automation frameworks for network validation, anomaly detection, testing, deployment assurance, and lifecycle management. Contribute to CI/CD, release management, and continuous improvement initiatives supporting network automation platforms. Document network systems, processes, automation workflows, and operational standards to support scalable and efficient operations. Provide technical recommendations and support strategic initiatives focused on network growth, modernization, reliability, and performance. What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related technical field. 2-3 years of experience in networking, systems engineering, network automation, or related infrastructure roles. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, subnetting, OSI model, packet flow analysis, and routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS, and EIGRP. Experience troubleshooting network connectivity and routing issues while supporting network device configurations in multi-vendor environments (Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, etc.). Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for network automation, operational tooling, data processing, and workflow optimization. Familiarity with network audits, configuration deployment, compliance validation, and network automation frameworks. Working knowledge of DevOps concepts including CI/CD pipelines, Git version control, infrastructure-as-code, and exposure to Docker and Kubernetes. Understanding of SQL and/or NoSQL databases and the ability to analyze network telemetry, configuration data, and operational datasets to drive network performance and reliability. Relevant industry certifications preferred, such as CCNA, JNCIA, or equivalent networking certifications. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment. Effective communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, operations, and business teams. Nice-to-have experience with AI/ML-assisted tools, network simulation platforms, or lab environments used for testing and validation. Disclaimer: This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications. Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Skills Cisco IP; Stakeholder Management; Juniper MX; Communication; Transmission Control Protocol (TCP); Network Operations; Scripting Salary New Jersey Pay Range: $78,505.90 - $117,758.85 Comcast intends to offer the selected candidate base pay within this range, dependent on job-related, non-discriminatory factors such as experience. The application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later. Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details. Education Bachelor's Degree While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience. Relevant Work Experience 2-5 Years

new_matches.title: Mainframe CICS Systems Engineer
new_matches.description: In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Lead Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering position at the Vice President level, which is part of the job family responsible for managing and optimizing technical infrastructure and ensuring the seamless operation of IT systems to support business needs effectively. Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals. Interested in joining a team that’s eager to create, innovate and make an impact on the world? Read on. Enterprise Technology & Services (ETS) delivers shared technology services for Morgan Stanley supporting all business applications and end users. ETS provides capabilities for all stages of Morgan Stanley's software development lifecycle, enabling productive coding, functional and integration testing, application releases, and ongoing monitoring and support for over 3,000 production applications. ETS also delivers all workplace technologies (desktop, mobile, voice, video, productivity, intranet/internet) in integrated configurations that boost the personal productivity of employees. Application and end user functions are delivered on a scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure composed of seamlessly integrated datacenter, network, compute, cloud, storage, and database functions. The Enterprise Z organization (EZ) is a technology enabler for the business by providing a strong, resilient, and stable platform to host and enable business innovation/growth in our lines of business and global locations. EZ consists of experienced administration, operations and engineering staff required to support the platform. In addition to flexible hours, the Firm enables its staff to work remotely. The EZ engineers work with the latest hardware and software technologies. The IBM z platform and the mainframe disk and tape technologies are frequently refreshed across our datacenters. The Mainframe CICS Systems Programmer/Engineer is responsible for all phases of CICS engineering, system and software maintenance, and CICS related operational functions. The candidate must be comfortable working with CICS in a 24x7 large scale Sysplex and CICSPlex environment and must be able to interface with application developers and operations teams. The CICS engineer should have strong analytical, organizational and communication skills, as well as in-depth knowledge in CICS performance & tuning, debugging and dump analysis. On-call support and maintenance outside of normal working hours are needed to support the CICS environment and to resolve issues. What You'll Bring To The Role Knowledge of SMP/E, software upgrades and maintenance Knowledge of all CICS parameters that control performance in a CICSPlex environment. Knowledge of CICS SMF record structure and the CICS Performance Analyzer tool to gather statistics necessary to tune CICS regions Experience with CICSPlex SM implementation & customization, dynamic transaction routing, etc. Knowledge of the CICS resource definitions, including those that pertain to CICS region performance Experienced with the CICS monitoring tools such as Sysview for CICS. Ability to perform problem determination, dump analysis and performance tuning Knowledge of Cobol to support application developers Experience with Mainframe Websphere MQ Excellent oral/written communication skills Skills Desired Assembler, COBOL and REXX coding and knowledge of CICS Exits Web application support in a CICS TS V6.x environment Understanding of zOS facilities such as: APF, Linklist, VSAM, LPA, RLS, Coupling Facility Utilization of CICS Configuration Manager Working knowledge of zOS & CICS Explorer Understanding of CICS REST Services Prior Application programming experience a plus. What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser. new_matches.title: Manufacturing IT Specialist
new_matches.description: We are looking for a Manufacturing IT Specialist to help keep our shop floor systems running. In this role, you will be the day-to-day support contact for our SAP manufacturing and warehouse applications (MES and EWM) and for the SCADA and data collection systems that connect them to production equipment. You will work directly with production, warehouse, quality, and maintenance teams — troubleshooting issues, keeping data flowing between the plant floor and SAP, and helping roll out improvements. This is a hands-on learning role, not a senior architect position. We are looking for solid fundamentals, curiosity, and a willingness to be on the plant floor. If you have a relevant degree or a couple of years of manufacturing IT, help desk, controls, or ERP support experience, we will train you on the rest. SAP MES / EWM Support Provide first- and second-level support for SAP manufacturing execution and Extended Warehouse Management users, including production reporting, material movements, goods receipts, picking, packing, and shipping transactions. Log, track, and resolve incidents and service requests; escalate complex issues to senior team members or external partners with clear documentation of what was tried. Monitor interfaces and background jobs between SAP and shop floor systems; identify failed or stuck transactions and correct them or coordinate the fix. Support master data accuracy for production and warehouse objects (materials, work centers, routings, storage bins, handling units) in coordination with business owners. Assist with testing, validation, and cutover activities for SAP changes, transports, patches, and new plant rollouts. Help train end users and write plain-language work instructions, quick reference guides, and troubleshooting steps. SCADA and Shop Floor Systems Support daily operation of SCADA / HMI applications used to monitor and control production lines, including alarm review, tag and screen changes, and basic configuration. Troubleshoot data collection issues between production equipment, PLCs, OPC servers, historians, and SAP — determining whether a problem is network, device, application, or data related. Maintain and support shop floor hardware and peripherals: industrial PCs, thin clients, barcode scanners, label printers, RF devices, wireless access points, and scoreboards or andon displays. Perform routine health checks, backups, patching, and license and certificate renewals on shop floor servers and workstations, following change control procedures. Assist with OT network hygiene and cybersecurity basics such as account reviews, segmentation checks, antivirus and patch compliance, and documenting connected devices. Projects and Continuous Improvement Participate as a team member on projects such as new line installations, equipment integrations, label or scanning changes, and MES or EWM enhancements. Gather requirements from plant users, document current and future state processes, and support configuration and testing. Keep system documentation, diagrams, and asset inventories current. Look for recurring issues and suggest permanent fixes or automation instead of repeat manual workarounds. Support after-hours changes and provide on-call coverage on a rotating basis to protect production schedules. To be a qualified candidate, you must have the following: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Technology, Electrical or Mechatronics Engineering, Automation, or a related field; OR a minimum of two (2) years of relevant work experience in place of a degree. Exposure to at least one of the following, through coursework, internship, co-op, or work experience: an ERP system (SAP preferred), a manufacturing execution or warehouse management system, or a SCADA / HMI / PLC environment. Basic troubleshooting ability across Windows operating systems, networking fundamentals (IP addressing, DNS, switches, VLANs), and relational databases. Comfortable reading data and writing basic queries (SQL) or scripts to investigate an issue. Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain a technical issue to a production supervisor and a business issue to a developer. Strong customer service mindset and the patience to support users during a live production shift. Willingness to work on the plant floor and to be available for occasional off-shift, weekend, or on-call support. Key to being successful in this role: Not required — these are what would make an application stand out. Hands-on experience with SAP ME / MII / Digital Manufacturing, or SAP EWM or WM transactions and RF handheld processes. Familiarity with a SCADA or industrial platform such as Ignition, AVEVA / Wonderware, FactoryTalk, WinCC, or Kepware, or with OPC UA data connectivity. Exposure to PLC platforms (Siemens, Allen-Bradley / Rockwell, Mitsubishi) at a read-and-understand level. Understanding of barcode and label printing (Zebra, SATO, BarTender, ZPL) and of RF / handheld scanning workflows. Experience in an automotive, Tier 1 supplier, or other high-volume manufacturing environment. Familiarity with ITIL-style incident and change management, or with a ticketing system such as ServiceNow or Jira. Scripting or reporting skills (Python, PowerShell, Power BI) and an interest in shop floor analytics. Relevant certifications (CompTIA A+ / Network+, SAP associate-level, or vendor automation training). Additional language skills, particularly Mandarin, given our global engineering and IT teams. Work Environment And Physical Requirements Split time between an office setting and an active manufacturing and warehouse floor. Required personal protective equipment (safety glasses, hearing protection, safety shoes) must be worn in designated areas; exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures. Frequent walking and standing throughout the facility; occasional lifting of equipment up to 25–50 lbs and use of ladders or lifts for device installations. Ability to work occasional off-shift hours, planned weekend maintenance windows, and rotating on-call support. Why work for Minth? Here are the advantages of working at Minth. new_matches.title: Operational Resilience Specialist
new_matches.description: Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. THE ROLE Propel enterprise operational readiness across Everpure by operating the core execution engine of our global resilience program. As an Operational Resilience Specialist, you will drive the end-to-end consistency, throughput, and accuracy of critical Business Impact Assessments (BIAs), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), and issue tracking systems. Partnering cross-functionally with system owners, IT operations, and risk leadership, you ensure our risk profile remains transparent and actionable, directly safeguarding organizational business continuity at scale. What You'll Do Drive Assessment Execution & Risk Visibility: Partner with system and application owners to conduct thorough Business Impact Assessments (BIAs) and Technical Impact Assessments (TIAs), establishing clear recovery objectives, critical business process dependencies, and risk baselines across the organization. Maintain Business Continuity Readiness: Facilitate the development, regular updates, and quality assurance of Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) to ensure alignment between evolving operational environments and business continuity requirements. Maintain Disaster Recovery Readiness: Facilitate the development, regular updates, testing, and quality assurance of Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs) and related recovery procedures. Coordinate Backup and Restore Readiness: Work with IT operations, system owners, and application teams to validate backup coverage, retention, restore procedures, and recovery dependencies. Manage Corrective Action & Escalation Pipelines: Direct the lifecycle tracking of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) arising from incidents, tabletop exercises, and audits, directly engaging action item owners to resolve delays and maintain accurate remediation records. Oversee Tool Integrity & System Reporting: Administer data entry and ongoing maintenance within Everpure’s enterprise governance and resilience tools, performing regular quality audits to provide leadership with clean, decision-ready compliance reporting. Coordinate Resilience Exercises & Process Improvement: Lead logistics, participant coordination, and documentation for simulation exercises, capturing output metrics and refining standard operating templates to continually elevate program delivery. What You Bring Execution & Ownership Discipline: Proven track record of managing multiple operational deliverables to closure with high detail orientation, structured follow-through, and reliable data management. Disaster Recovery & Backup/Recovery Expertise: Practical working experience supporting disaster recovery planning, testing, DRPs, and recovery procedures, along with strong knowledge of backup, restore, and recovery workflows, including backup coverage, retention, validation steps, recovery dependencies, and RTO/RPO considerations. Information Systems & System Administration Knowledge: Strong grasp of business continuity and IT infrastructure concepts, including how core enterprise applications, system relationships, infrastructure components, and technical dependencies interconnect. new_matches.title: Staff Database Engineer
new_matches.description: About Multi Media, LLC Multi Media, LLC is a global technology company operating a high-traffic live-streaming platform used by millions of people around the world. Behind the experience is a team solving challenging problems in real-time video, scalability, reliability, data, machine learning, and user experience. We’re a place for people who want their work to matter. Our teams have the autonomy to make decisions, the opportunity to work on problems at meaningful scale, and the ability to see their work shape experiences for a global audience in real time. We value curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The Role We are looking for a Staff Database Engineer to take primary ownership of the reliability, availability, and recoverability of our platform's large PostgreSQL environment. Our PostgreSQL estate operates at significant scale, spans multiple production clusters, holds terabytes of data, and has tables containing billions of rows. These databases support critical user experiences and revenue-generating features, and must be extremely reliable, support rapid recovery capabilities, and provide consistently high performance. You will work as part of the Site Reliability Engineering team to prevent database incidents, strengthen high availability and disaster recovery, improve confidence in our backup and restore procedures, and ensure that maintenance and upgrades can be completed safely. When incidents occur, you will provide the PostgreSQL expertise needed to diagnose complex failures, restore service, and prevent recurrence. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a business-critical database environment at substantial scale. You will have the autonomy to identify reliability risks, establish operational standards, influence architecture, and shape how PostgreSQL is operated as the platform continues to grow. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building resilient data infrastructure, not just administering it. What You’ll Do Own the day-to-day reliability and operational health of our platform's PostgreSQL environment. Identify and proactively address database reliability, performance, and scalability risks before they impact production. Improve high availability, replication, backup, restore, and disaster recovery capabilities. Lead the response to database incidents and implement improvements that prevent them from recurring. Plan and execute PostgreSQL upgrades, migrations, and maintenance with minimal service disruption. Monitor and tune database performance across high-volume, latency-sensitive, high-write workloads. Build better observability, alerting, automation, and operational runbooks in partnership with SRE. Plan for continued growth in data volume, storage, compute, WAL generation, replication bandwidth and latency needs. Review database architecture for new products and significant engineering changes, providing guidance on schema design, queries, migrations, scalability, and operational risk. Develop operational standards, automation, and best practices for PostgreSQL across the engineering organization. Document the environment and help SRE engineers build stronger PostgreSQL knowledge. Participate in an on-call rotation for critical database incidents. Analyze query execution plans, indexing strategy, autovacuum behavior, table bloat, checkpoint tuning, and storage efficiency for multi-terabyte database clusters. Requirements What You Bring 10+ years of hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL in large-scale, business-critical production environments. Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL reliability, including replication, failover, backup, recovery, and high availability. Experience in preventing, diagnosing, and resolving complex production database incidents. Experience in planning and safely executing PostgreSQL upgrades, migrations, and maintenance. Strong understanding of PostgreSQL internals, including WAL, autovacuum, indexing, locking, query planning, and connection management. Experience supporting high-volume workloads, large data sets, or rapidly growing databases. Strong Linux knowledge and an understanding of how infrastructure affects database performance and reliability. Ability to automate operational work through scripting, configuration management, or infrastructure tooling. Experience building monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and reliable incident-response practices. Strong communication and judgment, with the ability to work effectively across SRE and product engineering teams. Nice to Have Experience with Patroni, PgBouncer, or comparable PostgreSQL high-availability and connection-pooling technologies. Experience designing or testing multi-region database recovery strategies. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and modern observability platforms. Experience building PostgreSQL operational knowledge within an SRE or infrastructure organization. Experience supporting high-traffic consumer platforms, real-time systems, or revenue-critical transaction flows. Experience with the Python Django web framework. Benefits What You’ll Get Fair and competitive base salary Fully Remote Optional Health, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance for you and any dependents, with policy premiums covered by the Company Long & Short term disability insurance Unlimited PTO Annual Year-End Company Closure Optional 401k with 5% matching 12 Paid Holidays Paid Lunches in-office, or if Remote, a $125/week stipend via Sharebite Employee Assistance and Employee Recognition Programs And much more! new_matches.title: ASIC Verification Engineer - Clocks
new_matches.description: The NVIDIA Clocks Team is looking for an excellent Senior ASIC Verification engineer with extensive experience in Design Verification. The NVIDIA Clocks Team is committed to deliver high-quality clocking and reset logic to various units in SOC automotive and datacenter ASICs. The complexity of the clocks and resets design has increased many folds. This requires sophisticated verification to deliver a bug free clocks/resets design to power our product lines ranging from Data Centers, Consumer graphics to Self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. Modern clocking verification solutions need to be innovative, ensure quality in covering the complex design specifications and balance the constraints on infrastructure, re-usability, testing speed and multi-platform support. What You'll Be Doing Own validation of Clocking structures in Tegra automotive and datacenter products from start to finish, including test plan development, automation, validation flows development, coverage metrics, test execution, bug identification/fix and productization. Tackle Sophisticated problems and develop a scalable solution that works across platform. Hands on industry-standard tools and state of the art verification methodologies. This includes coding in System Verilog, UVM, C++, Perl, Python and NVIDIA custom compilers and tools. Partnering closely with our clocks/reset architecture and design team to validate our clocks/reset design. Coordinate with internal and external teams across time zones. What We Need To See BS or MS in EE/ECE or equivalent experience. 2+ years of relevant industry work experience. Good understanding of Logic Design and Architecture. Expertise in industry-standard verification flows like SV constraint random verification, UVM, Formal Verification, Coverage metrics, profiling tools, X prop, etc. Exposure on block level and system-level verification. Strong coding skills in System Verilog, scripting languages (Perl/python) and C++. Ability to collaborate and work with multiple groups. Prior experience in implementing Test plans for pre-silicon platforms. Understanding of DFT/IST is optional. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you are creative, curious, and motivated with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! , , JR2024826

new_matches.title: Senior Remote Services Engineer
new_matches.description: Job Description As a Senior Remote Services Engineer (Level 2) here at Honeywell, you will be part of the Global Remote Buildings Operation Team providing 24/7 engineering response and support to Honeywell Connected Sites worldwide under defined Service Level Agreements (SLA). You will be the first point of contact for our contracted customer base, ensuring their issues are resolved expediently and in accordance with SLA agreements by offering remote fixes, escalating to Field Engineering Teams when necessary, and directly interfacing with customers. You will report directly to our Team Lead and you’ll work out of our Independence, OH location on a shift-based work schedule. In this role, you will impact customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by delivering expert remote technical assistance, driving energy savings, and continuously improving product quality and service offerings. Responsibilities KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Provide remote technical assistance for global multi-brand contracted customers. Coordinate with Team Lead when customer interactions fall outside defined contract requirements. Manage global customer requests with varying levels of expertise. Perform fault finding on building service plant equipment and systems. Liaise with third-party providers on non-BEMS related problems to enhance customer service. Represent technical issues from both Field Service and customer sites at appropriate technical forums. Drive energy savings through applying BEMS expertise. Liaise with Field Service Account Handlers to resolve customer queries. Ensure achievement of all team and individual targets and KPIs. Execute assigned tasks per procedures and instructions within the contract framework. Understand customer requirements for functional setup of customer sites. Verify analytical results against internal guidelines. Produce, validate, and forward customer reports. Update customer systems to meet required functionalities. Notify involved parties in case of non-conformities. Document workflows for repetitive customer activities. Continuously improve product quality and performance. Make decisions based on defined authority and responsibilities. Work closely with Technical Support and Engineering Teams on product issues. Carry out development project work to enhance global services offerings. Train and mentor Level 1 operators. Collaborate with senior leadership to refine and improve current offerings. Qualifications YOU MUST HAVE Minimum of 2 years demonstrable experience in Maintenance, Repair, Installation & Operation of Building Energy Management Systems (BEMS). Minimum of 2 years of experience working on Building Energy Management Systems. Minimum of 2 years of experience working directly with customers in person or over the phone. Ability to work a 24/7 shift pattern. High school diploma or equivalent. WE VALUE Exposure to identifying or supporting service revenue opportunities (T&M, SPOT, upgrades). Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Commercial awareness and ability to identify value-based opportunities. Experience working in remote operations centers / digital services. Knowledge of managed services or connected building platforms. Bachelor’s degree in HVAC, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, or related discipline. Industry experience is preferred. Significant customer service experience. Demonstrated experience with knowledge management and call center management. Experience in a field environment is advantageous. Benefits Of Working For Honeywell In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. For more information visit: Benefits at Honeywell The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
